meta.title: Double Attack
meta.description: When black makes its move, it threatens a two-pronged attack.

units.rawText: Sanctifier Watchtower 05.
units.displayText: Sanctifier Watchtower 05.

spans.text: Sanctifier Watchtower 05.

units.rawText: Eucharist's offense rages on, applying pressure with every move.
units.displayText: Eucharist's offense rages on, applying pressure with every move.

spans.text: Eucharist's offense rages on, applying pressure with every move.

units.rawText: Still turtling up over there, are we? You won't have a chance of winning if this continues, Professor.
units.displayText: Still turtling up over there, are we? You won't have a chance of winning if this continues, Professor.

spans.text: Still turtling up over there, are we? You won't have a chance of winning if this continues, Professor.

units.rawText: Or maybe we're feeling some regret over giving up that chance to take material, hmm?
units.displayText: Or maybe we're feeling some regret over giving up that chance to take material, hmm?

spans.text: Or maybe we're feeling some regret over giving up that chance to take material, hmm?

units.rawText: Provocation won't work on me.
units.displayText: Provocation won't work on me.

spans.text: Provocation won't work on me.

units.rawText: I place my piece, neutralizing Eucharist's attack.
units.displayText: I place my piece, neutralizing Eucharist's attack.

spans.text: I place my piece, neutralizing Eucharist's attack.

units.rawText: For this "city" of mine as it is, defense matters most.
units.displayText: For this "city" of mine as it is, defense matters most.

spans.text: For this "city" of mine as it is, defense matters most.

units.rawText: I shall pray that your pieces will do as you wish, then.
units.displayText: I shall pray that your pieces will do as you wish, then.

spans.text: I shall pray that your pieces will do as you wish, then.

units.rawText: I do not see them as mere pieces. That is why they always surpass my wildest imaginations.
units.displayText: I do not see them as mere pieces. That is why they always surpass my wildest imaginations.

spans.text: I do not see them as mere pieces. That is why they always surpass my wildest imaginations.

units.rawText: Heehee... I must confess that I find you quite entertaining when you are unfoundedly confident, Professor.
units.displayText: Heehee... I must confess that I find you quite entertaining when you are unfoundedly confident, Professor.

spans.text: Heehee... I must confess that I find you quite entertaining when you are unfoundedly confident, Professor.

units.rawText: Though—simply continuing like this is far too boring.
units.displayText: Though—simply continuing like this is far too boring.

spans.text: Though—simply continuing like this is far too boring.

units.rawText: Eucharist takes the black queen into her hands, closely admiring it.
units.displayText: Eucharist takes the black queen into her hands, closely admiring it.

spans.text: Eucharist takes the black queen into her hands, closely admiring it.

units.rawText: Let me spice it up a little bit.
units.displayText: Let me spice it up a little bit.

spans.text: Let me spice it up a little bit.

units.rawText: <size=40>THUMP!</size>
units.displayText: THUMP!

spans.text: THUMP!

units.rawText: Eucharist raises her arm high, slamming the black queen onto the board!
units.displayText: Eucharist raises her arm high, slamming the black queen onto the board!

spans.text: Eucharist raises her arm high, slamming the black queen onto the board!

units.rawText: Abruptly, the entirety of the room begins to tremble as the scenery rapidly transforms again. The skulking Entropics in the vicinity seem to feel something shuffling and stirring.
units.displayText: Abruptly, the entirety of the room begins to tremble as the scenery rapidly transforms again. The skulking Entropics in the vicinity seem to feel something shuffling and stirring.

spans.text: Abruptly, the entirety of the room begins to tremble as the scenery rapidly transforms again. The skulking Entropics in the vicinity seem to feel something shuffling and stirring.

units.rawText: Eucharist!
units.displayText: Eucharist!

spans.text: Eucharist!

units.rawText: Now, now, allow me some mild amusement. What type of dimwit would I have to be to let such a game end like this?
units.displayText: Now, now, allow me some mild amusement. What type of dimwit would I have to be to let such a game end like this?

spans.text: Now, now, allow me some mild amusement. What type of dimwit would I have to be to let such a game end like this?

units.rawText: Right, Ptolemaea?
units.displayText: Right, Ptolemaea?

spans.text: Right, Ptolemaea?

units.rawText: Be quiet, children.
units.displayText: Be quiet, children.

spans.text: Be quiet, children.

units.rawText: An airy voice emerges from a jellyfish-shaped Entropic, repressing the agitation in the nearby Entropics.
units.displayText: An airy voice emerges from a jellyfish-shaped Entropic, repressing the agitation in the nearby Entropics.

spans.text: An airy voice emerges from a jellyfish-shaped Entropic, repressing the agitation in the nearby Entropics.

units.rawText: I understand.
units.displayText: I understand.

spans.text: I understand.

units.rawText: The hint of danger in the air departs as the voice does, as if it all truly was a mere sideshow, interjected into the middle of this game.
units.displayText: The hint of danger in the air departs as the voice does, as if it all truly was a mere sideshow, interjected into the middle of this game.

spans.text: The hint of danger in the air departs as the voice does, as if it all truly was a mere sideshow, interjected into the middle of this game.

units.rawText: —Save for the crevices left by the black queen.
units.displayText: —Save for the crevices left by the black queen.

spans.text: —Save for the crevices left by the black queen.

units.rawText: Oops, I might've overdone it a bit.
units.displayText: Oops, I might've overdone it a bit.

spans.text: Oops, I might've overdone it a bit.

units.rawText: The crevices expand from under the queen, dividing the board into disparate chunks. I hear a sound akin to the rumblings of crumbling earth.
units.displayText: The crevices expand from under the queen, dividing the board into disparate chunks. I hear a sound akin to the rumblings of crumbling earth.

spans.text: The crevices expand from under the queen, dividing the board into disparate chunks. I hear a sound akin to the rumblings of crumbling earth.

units.rawText: <size=40>BOOM—!</size>
units.displayText: BOOM—!

spans.text: BOOM—!

units.rawText: Null Area, the Oasis' Backup Communication Node 4.
units.displayText: Null Area, the Oasis' Backup Communication Node 4.

spans.text: Null Area, the Oasis' Backup Communication Node 4.

units.rawText: The ground buckles piece by piece as purple Entropic fluid subsumes the communications building. What remains hardly bears a resemblance to the construct that once stood here.
units.displayText: The ground buckles piece by piece as purple Entropic fluid subsumes the communications building. What remains hardly bears a resemblance to the construct that once stood here.

spans.text: The ground buckles piece by piece as purple Entropic fluid subsumes the communications building. What remains hardly bears a resemblance to the construct that once stood here.

units.rawText: <color=purple>...It is done.</color>
units.displayText: ...It is done.

spans.text: ...It is done.

units.rawText: The jellyfish-like Entropics gently descend from the leftover debris, shambling to her side, intimately brushing her hand with their bells.
units.displayText: The jellyfish-like Entropics gently descend from the leftover debris, shambling to her side, intimately brushing her hand with their bells.

spans.text: The jellyfish-like Entropics gently descend from the leftover debris, shambling to her side, intimately brushing her hand with their bells.

units.rawText: <color=purple>Yes, that will do. We can leave these things here. It will be fine to leave these here. It's no matter if they are repaired.</color>
units.displayText: Yes, that will do. We can leave these things here. It will be fine to leave these here. It's no matter if they are repaired.

spans.text: Yes, that will do. We can leave these things here. It will be fine to leave these here. It's no matter if they are repaired.

units.rawText: <color=purple>Hehe, no need to rush. We are still in the prelude, and the time to dance is yet to come.</color>
units.displayText: Hehe, no need to rush. We are still in the prelude, and the time to dance is yet to come.

spans.text: Hehe, no need to rush. We are still in the prelude, and the time to dance is yet to come.

units.rawText: She bows down, lightly patting an Entropic, looking towards the Oasis shattered in the distance.
units.displayText: She bows down, lightly patting an Entropic, looking towards the Oasis shattered in the distance.

spans.text: She bows down, lightly patting an Entropic, looking towards the Oasis shattered in the distance.

units.rawText: <color=purple>We do approach our stage, however...</color>
units.displayText: We do approach our stage, however...

spans.text: We do approach our stage, however...

units.rawText: <color=purple>Soon, children. A little longer.</color>
units.displayText: Soon, children. A little longer.

spans.text: Soon, children. A little longer.

units.rawText: The jellyfish Entropics clamber onto her body, melding into the darkness along with her.
units.displayText: The jellyfish Entropics clamber onto her body, melding into the darkness along with her.

spans.text: The jellyfish Entropics clamber onto her body, melding into the darkness along with her.

units.rawText: In the Null Area's blankness, only the hallowed echoing of song remains.
units.displayText: In the Null Area's blankness, only the hallowed echoing of song remains.

spans.text: In the Null Area's blankness, only the hallowed echoing of song remains.

units.rawText: <color=purple>Let us dance to our heart's desire, children.</color>
units.displayText: Let us dance to our heart's desire, children.

spans.text: Let us dance to our heart's desire, children.

units.rawText: <color=purple>Into the distance we fly, as the song tide comes.</color>
units.displayText: Into the distance we fly, as the song tide comes.

spans.text: Into the distance we fly, as the song tide comes.

units.rawText: <color=red>So we shall persist... until the end.</color>
units.displayText: So we shall persist... until the end.

spans.text: So we shall persist... until the end.

units.rawText: The Oasis, Ops Room.
units.displayText: The Oasis, Ops Room.

spans.text: The Oasis, Ops Room.

units.rawText: The team responsible for restoring communications has left the range of currently available communications for some time.
units.displayText: The team responsible for restoring communications has left the range of currently available communications for some time.

spans.text: The team responsible for restoring communications has left the range of currently available communications for some time.

units.rawText: According to the plan, they'll prioritize working on the backup communication nodes.
units.displayText: According to the plan, they'll prioritize working on the backup communication nodes.

spans.text: According to the plan, they'll prioritize working on the backup communication nodes.

units.rawText: I see, since the infrastructure directly in the path of the railgun will have suffered more damage and require more time to repair. Starting from the backup nodes further out is the better route to take.
units.displayText: I see, since the infrastructure directly in the path of the railgun will have suffered more damage and require more time to repair. Starting from the backup nodes further out is the better route to take.

spans.text: I see, since the infrastructure directly in the path of the railgun will have suffered more damage and require more time to repair. Starting from the backup nodes further out is the better route to take.

units.rawText: We can only hope their efforts are successful.
units.displayText: We can only hope their efforts are successful.

spans.text: We can only hope their efforts are successful.

units.rawText: Beeeep—a warning interrupts the conversation.
units.displayText: Beeeep—a warning interrupts the conversation.

spans.text: Beeeep—a warning interrupts the conversation.

units.rawText: An inner building in Zone C's data backup center has been infested by Entropics... but how? Simo already cleaned up that area previously...
units.displayText: An inner building in Zone C's data backup center has been infested by Entropics... but how? Simo already cleaned up that area previously...

spans.text: An inner building in Zone C's data backup center has been infested by Entropics... but how? Simo already cleaned up that area previously...

units.rawText: No, it's not just Zone C, but the nearby Zones A and B too?!
units.displayText: No, it's not just Zone C, but the nearby Zones A and B too?!

spans.text: No, it's not just Zone C, but the nearby Zones A and B too?!

units.rawText: Daiyan, initiate emergency procedures, contact the heads of each Zone, and find out what exactly is going on!
units.displayText: Daiyan, initiate emergency procedures, contact the heads of each Zone, and find out what exactly is going on!

spans.text: Daiyan, initiate emergency procedures, contact the heads of each Zone, and find out what exactly is going on!

units.rawText: Persicaria! Incoming emergency call from Horizon!
units.displayText: Persicaria! Incoming emergency call from Horizon!

spans.text: Persicaria! Incoming emergency call from Horizon!

units.rawText: At a time like this... put her through!
units.displayText: At a time like this... put her through!

spans.text: At a time like this... put her through!

units.rawText: Persicaria, the Entropics have launched a retaliatory attack on the area we're performing repairs in!
units.displayText: Persicaria, the Entropics have launched a retaliatory attack on the area we're performing repairs in!

spans.text: Persicaria, the Entropics have launched a retaliatory attack on the area we're performing repairs in!

units.rawText: Magnhilda is heading the defense for now, but she can't hold out for long. We need reinforcements!
units.displayText: Magnhilda is heading the defense for now, but she can't hold out for long. We need reinforcements!

spans.text: Magnhilda is heading the defense for now, but she can't hold out for long. We need reinforcements!

units.rawText: Pressed on two fronts... you'll have to force boot the Sandbox Barrier to defend your position!
units.displayText: Pressed on two fronts... you'll have to force boot the Sandbox Barrier to defend your position!

spans.text: Pressed on two fronts... you'll have to force boot the Sandbox Barrier to defend your position!

units.rawText: We tried, but that thing's sucked the barrier in Zone G dry.
units.displayText: We tried, but that thing's sucked the barrier in Zone G dry.

spans.text: We tried, but that thing's sucked the barrier in Zone G dry.

units.rawText: We barely managed to get it back online and communicating with the Ops Room with the operands we had.
units.displayText: We barely managed to get it back online and communicating with the Ops Room with the operands we had.

spans.text: We barely managed to get it back online and communicating with the Ops Room with the operands we had.

units.rawText: And we need these operands to defend ourselves. If it wasn't for those supplies, our defenses would have been breached just then!
units.displayText: And we need these operands to defend ourselves. If it wasn't for those supplies, our defenses would have been breached just then!

spans.text: And we need these operands to defend ourselves. If it wasn't for those supplies, our defenses would have been breached just then!

units.rawText: How...
units.displayText: How...

spans.text: How...

units.rawText: Captain Horizon! The balloon sent out to lure away that Entropic jellyfish is streaming back imaging data!
units.displayText: Captain Horizon! The balloon sent out to lure away that Entropic jellyfish is streaming back imaging data!

spans.text: Captain Horizon! The balloon sent out to lure away that Entropic jellyfish is streaming back imaging data!

units.rawText: It wasn't shot down?
units.displayText: It wasn't shot down?

spans.text: It wasn't shot down?

units.rawText: I-I thought the same thing, but the jellyfish Entropic lost interest in it all of a sudden!
units.displayText: I-I thought the same thing, but the jellyfish Entropic lost interest in it all of a sudden!

spans.text: I-I thought the same thing, but the jellyfish Entropic lost interest in it all of a sudden!

units.rawText: I've sent it to you guys!
units.displayText: I've sent it to you guys!

spans.text: I've sent it to you guys!

units.rawText: Persicaria opens Mai's message. The mysterious Entropic is akin to a great banner in a churning sea of purple as the Low Order Entropics about it moves forth in an orderly fashion.
units.displayText: Persicaria opens Mai's message. The mysterious Entropic is akin to a great banner in a churning sea of purple as the Low Order Entropics about it moves forth in an orderly fashion.

spans.text: Persicaria opens Mai's message. The mysterious Entropic is akin to a great banner in a churning sea of purple as the Low Order Entropics about it moves forth in an orderly fashion.

units.rawText: There's... some type of sound...
units.displayText: There's... some type of sound...

spans.text: There's... some type of sound...

units.rawText: The Entropics stream forward in rhythm, emitting a variety of ill-defined sounds.
units.displayText: The Entropics stream forward in rhythm, emitting a variety of ill-defined sounds.

spans.text: The Entropics stream forward in rhythm, emitting a variety of ill-defined sounds.

units.rawText: <color=purple>Towards... the song...</color>
units.displayText: Towards... the song...

spans.text: Towards... the song...

units.rawText: ...Singing?
units.displayText: ...Singing?

spans.text: ...Singing?

units.rawText: For Low Order Entropics to make such precise movements... just what is controlling them?!
units.displayText: For Low Order Entropics to make such precise movements... just what is controlling them?!

spans.text: For Low Order Entropics to make such precise movements... just what is controlling them?!

units.rawText: Apologies, Persicaria, we have an emergency. I've made contact with Hubble!
units.displayText: Apologies, Persicaria, we have an emergency. I've made contact with Hubble!

spans.text: Apologies, Persicaria, we have an emergency. I've made contact with Hubble!

units.rawText: According to her, a strange Entropic similar to a jellyfish in appearance is running amok in the Oasis; it's infecting buildings and agents.
units.displayText: According to her, a strange Entropic similar to a jellyfish in appearance is running amok in the Oasis; it's infecting buildings and agents.

spans.text: According to her, a strange Entropic similar to a jellyfish in appearance is running amok in the Oasis; it's infecting buildings and agents.

units.rawText: Jellyfish Entropics, in the Oasis?! Why...
units.displayText: Jellyfish Entropics, in the Oasis?! Why...

spans.text: Jellyfish Entropics, in the Oasis?! Why...

units.rawText: The Sandbox Barrier is bleeding operands! Can we get any coordinates on where it's happening?
units.displayText: The Sandbox Barrier is bleeding operands! Can we get any coordinates on where it's happening?

spans.text: The Sandbox Barrier is bleeding operands! Can we get any coordinates on where it's happening?

units.rawText: Ahh... it keeps on changing, and operands are being siphoned out of two faraway coordinates simultaneously.
units.displayText: Ahh... it keeps on changing, and operands are being siphoned out of two faraway coordinates simultaneously.

spans.text: Ahh... it keeps on changing, and operands are being siphoned out of two faraway coordinates simultaneously.

units.rawText: So one of them entered the Oasis during all of that... I should have taken notice!
units.displayText: So one of them entered the Oasis during all of that... I should have taken notice!

spans.text: So one of them entered the Oasis during all of that... I should have taken notice!

units.rawText: Hubble and others have dug up its general location using the instruments in the backup center, but they'll need reinforcements to take care of it!
units.displayText: Hubble and others have dug up its general location using the instruments in the backup center, but they'll need reinforcements to take care of it!

spans.text: Hubble and others have dug up its general location using the instruments in the backup center, but they'll need reinforcements to take care of it!

units.rawText: We have so few reserves left...
units.displayText: We have so few reserves left...

spans.text: We have so few reserves left...

units.rawText: With this amount of personnel, splitting forces might result in a breakdown on both sides.
units.displayText: With this amount of personnel, splitting forces might result in a breakdown on both sides.

spans.text: With this amount of personnel, splitting forces might result in a breakdown on both sides.

units.rawText: A decision has to be made fast on which problem to solve.
units.displayText: A decision has to be made fast on which problem to solve.

spans.text: A decision has to be made fast on which problem to solve.

units.rawText: Which side to choose?
units.displayText: Which side to choose?

spans.text: Which side to choose?

units.rawText: If we don't take care of this thorn inside the Oasis, the infection will only continue to spread. The outcome will be indescribable!
units.displayText: If we don't take care of this thorn inside the Oasis, the infection will only continue to spread. The outcome will be indescribable!

spans.text: If we don't take care of this thorn inside the Oasis, the infection will only continue to spread. The outcome will be indescribable!

units.rawText: Same goes for Zone G. If we allow these Entropics to do as they please in the Oasis...
units.displayText: Same goes for Zone G. If we allow these Entropics to do as they please in the Oasis...

spans.text: Same goes for Zone G. If we allow these Entropics to do as they please in the Oasis...

units.rawText: Persicaria's nails dig into her palm. The existence of countless agents weighs down the words in her throat.
units.displayText: Persicaria's nails dig into her palm. The existence of countless agents weighs down the words in her throat.

spans.text: Persicaria's nails dig into her palm. The existence of countless agents weighs down the words in her throat.

units.rawText: ...But I don't want to give up either.
units.displayText: ...But I don't want to give up either.

spans.text: ...But I don't want to give up either.

units.rawText: What to do? The flow of time slows down to a crawl as countless numerical lives fly by, second by second.
units.displayText: What to do? The flow of time slows down to a crawl as countless numerical lives fly by, second by second.

spans.text: What to do? The flow of time slows down to a crawl as countless numerical lives fly by, second by second.

units.rawText: Only the song continues.
units.displayText: Only the song continues.

spans.text: Only the song continues.

units.rawText: <color=purple>Fly... Fly... Into the distance...</color>
units.displayText: Fly... Fly... Into the distance...

spans.text: Fly... Fly... Into the distance...

units.rawText: <color=purple>Until the end...</color>
units.displayText: Until the end...

spans.text: Until the end...
